periods.time: Opening frame of the special volume

name.zh: 破军学园壁报特别版开幕

periods.summary: Kagami Kusakabe and Nagi Arisuin introduce a special wall-newspaper edition collecting side incidents that missed ordinary publication deadlines.
periods.cause: Kagami wants to report unprinted Hagun incidents and pulls Alice in because the news club lacks manpower.
periods.process: Kagami theatrically greets readers, coerces Alice into assisting by invoking his earlier stabbing of her, and previews the first story set after Ikki defeats Kirihara.
periods.outcome: The volume is framed as a series of six wall-newspaper side stories with intermission commentary by Kagami and Alice.
periods.significance: Establishes the anthology structure and source of the narrated side episodes.
